meta.name: WorldMill HUD — design tokens
meta.pass: Restraint pass: ink on dark glass, mostly empty screen. 2.1 adds title, pause and settings menus.
meta.scaling: px are authored at 1080p. Unity multiplies by max(0.6, Screen.height / 1080); hairlines stay max(1, round(scale)) px.
meta.colorSpace: Hex is sRGB. Unity Color floats are sRGB (hex / 255): assign as-is in a linear HDRP project, never pre-linearize.

ink.usage: All text and hairlines, at the opacities below

gold.usage: Where to look and what is chosen: quest diamond, active hotbar slot, boss phase notch, focused menu item rule, active tab underline, chosen toggle option, slider fill and thumb. Never on text, frames or large fills.

hpTrail.usage: Damage trail behind the health fill

xp.usage: 2px XP hairline; the one passive use of gold, kept dim

scrim.usage: Full-screen dim behind the journal; left menu scrim ramp at 82%; pause dim at 22%

barBorder.usage: 1px dark border around HP and stamina

textShadow.usage: 1px offset shadow; firmer when the sun is high and the sky bright

families.unityNote: Font.CreateDynamicFontFromOSFont with the first installed name; falls back to GUI.skin.font.

detailTitle.usage: Selected quest, lore entry or item

type.case: Sentence case for all UI text. Title case only for place names (Oakhaven Crossing) and boss names; quest, item and lore titles keep the casing the store gives them. No uppercase tracking, no emoji.

scrim.note: Never an opaque box; the live world stays visible

title.subtitle: Oakhaven Crossing
items: Continue (only with save progress; meta: Lv. n · active quest)
New journey (inline confirm when progress exists)
title.focus: ink strong + 18 × 1px gold rule, 32px left of the text
title.camera: WorldMillPlayerController orbits Oakhaven (512, 466): radius 118 m, +44 m, 1.6°/s; eases back to the shoulder camera over 1.6 s

settings.toggle: text options; chosen = ink strong + 1px gold underline, others ink faint
settings.button: 1px frame hairlineStrong, hover/focus 55% + 6% wash (same as journal Track)
settings.confirm: inline: Start fresh?  Confirm  Cancel — Cancel focused by default
settings.persistence: Application.persistentDataPath/worldmill_settings.json, debounced 350 ms after a change and on close

escape: Settings → back to Pause or Title

motion.trailDrain: max(gap × 3.5, 0.18) per second after the delay; continuous drains under 1.5% per frame do not reset the delay
motion.uiClock: All UI fades use Time.unscaledDeltaTime; pause sets Time.timeScale = 0 and restores 1 on resume, return to title, OnDisable and OnDestroy
motion.reducedMotion: Keep fades, drop pulses and the toast rise

rules: The screen belongs to the world: no panel behind vitals, tracker or compass.
Gold marks where to look next or what is chosen: quest diamond, hotbar slot, boss notch, menu focus, active tab, toggle choice, slider fill. Nothing else.
1px hairlines only. No chamfers, glows, gradients on chrome, or rounded corners.
Shadows exist for legibility over bright sky, not for decoration.
Show only what the store knows: quests, lore and items come from WorldMillLocalRpgStore.
H hides everything; J opens the journal and frees the cursor; Esc closes it.
Menus sit on the live world: left gradient scrim, editorial serif list, no boxes behind items.
No stock IMGUI chrome: every button, toggle and slider is drawn from hairlines and text.
Esc always steps back one level: confirm, settings, journal, dialogue, then pause.
